decisions.statement: One backup out of each week is kept once that week is over.
One backup out of each month is kept once that month is over.
A keep marking this package did not make is left untouched.
A keep marking this package did not make is reported.
The barman version installed in the image is the version the backup plugin's sidecar runs.
A copy on to slower storage is complete only once the copy's hashes are written.
The cluster runs the promoter and the longtail copier on a schedule.
